gloss: ten-odd years; a dozen or so years

definitions.gloss: ten-odd years; somewhere between ten and twenty years
definitions.explanation: An approximate span of more than ten but fewer than twenty years. The {数|すう} in the middle is what makes the figure vague; the same slot works with other counters, as in {十数人|じゅうすうにん} (ten-odd people).

examples.japanese: {十数年|じゅうすうねん}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことだ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十数年|じゅうすうねん}⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: This shop has been going for over ten years.

examples.japanese: {十数年|じゅうすうねん}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{故郷|こきょう}→故郷：02733_kokyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧、⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{変|か}わりよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I returned to my hometown for the first time in ten-odd years and was startled by how much it had changed.

notes:
The ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ slot creates an approximate figure in the teens; the pattern extends to other counters.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {十数年|じゅうすうねん}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: ten-odd years ago
- {十数年|じゅうすうねん}⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧: for the first time in ten-odd years
- {十数人|じゅうすうにん}: ten-odd people
- {十数回|じゅうすうかい}: ten-odd times

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{数十年|すうじゅうねん}→数十年：30639_suujuunen⟧: several decades — the same characters in the other order, but far longer (roughly 20–90 years)
- ⟦{何十年|なんじゅうねん}→何十年：30624_nanjuunen⟧: decades — vaguer and often emotional, as in "for decades now"
